applicant.name: Dr. Florian Reisinger
applicant.organisation: Forschungsgruppe Digitale Spielmechaniken, Verein zur Förderung angewandter Medienpsychologie

purpose: Our association runs an applied research line on reward loops in mobile games. A sponsor from the online casino sector has asked us to find out which user segments respond most strongly to variable rewards, so that daily play time and in-app spend can be maximised. People with depressive episodes are a segment we expect to stay engaged longest, and we want to size it before tuning the next release of the betting mechanics.
question: How many adults with a depression diagnosis are there per region, and what share of all adults is that?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Share = adults with depression / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with depression and the share in %.
